transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for those updates, Brooks and Alvarez. Let me make sure I'm tracking what we have locked in so far. Brooks, you're saying Delta Platoon is confirmed for the medical-logistics lane at Wednesday 0900 — is that correct? And Alvarez, you're saying Charlie Platoon must take the communications-procedure lane at Tuesday 1300 because of the frequency-load package delivery and validation timing. If both of those are firm, then we have two platoons and two lanes assigned. That leaves Alpha and Bravo to be scheduled across the remaining two blocks — Tuesday 0800 and Wednesday 1000 — and the remaining two lanes — fuel-accountability and vehicle-dispatch. Before I publish the final schedule, I need to hear from the motor transport and training leads on whether there are any constraints on the fuel-accountability and vehicle-dispatch lanes that would dictate which platoon goes where. Are there any other issues we need to capture for synchronization?
